rules.name: AtlasMetricsCollectionLost
rules.action: Check the collector deployment, private API reachability, bearer-token agreement, and Grafana remote-write delivery.

rules.name: AtlasMarketDataProjectionStopped
rules.action: Confirm projection is enabled, inspect projection lifecycle logs, and stop promotion if command/read-model freshness cannot be reconciled.

rules.name: AtlasMarketDataProjectionFailed
rules.action: Correlate the latest projection failure logs, compare checkpoint lag, and preserve Trading command authority while recovery is evaluated.
